title: Vulnerability digest — 24 Nov 2026, 21:05 CET
markdown:
- **CVE-2026-135506**, Mozilla Firefox, Mozilla Thunderbird: It allows a sandbox escape in the Graphics: Text component, which was fixed in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135506), [Bugzilla](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2067949), [Advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-131/)
- **CVE-2026-135510**, Mozilla Firefox, Mozilla Thunderbird: It permits a sandbox escape within the Networking: HTTP component, with a fix available in Firefox 161 and Thunderbird 161. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135510), [Bugzilla](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2075411), [Advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-131/)
- **CVE-2026-135520**, Mozilla Firefox, Mozilla Thunderbird: It features a sandbox escape in the Graphics: CanvasWebGL component, resolved in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 115.46, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135520), [Bugzilla](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2080133), [Advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-131/)
- **CVE-2026-135521**, Mozilla Firefox, Mozilla Thunderbird: It involves a sandbox escape in the DOM: Navigation component, addressed in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 115.46, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135521), [Bugzilla](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2080757), [Advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-131/)
- **CVE-2026-135529**, Mozilla Firefox, Mozilla Thunderbird: It contains a sandbox escape in the Graphics: Text component, fixed in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135529), [Bugzilla](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2086014), [Advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-131/)
- **CVE-2026-135530**, Mozilla Firefox, Mozilla Thunderbird: It allows a sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Networking: HTTP component, which was fixed in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 115.46, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135530), [Bugzilla](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2086293), [Advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-131/)
- **CVE-2026-135547**, Mozilla Firefox, Mozilla Thunderbird: It has a sandbox escape caused by incorrect boundary conditions in the DOM: Networking component, fixed in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 115.46, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135547), [Bugzilla](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2090172), [Advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-131/)
- **CVE-2026-135596**, Mozilla Firefox, Mozilla Thunderbird: It presents a sandbox escape resulting from incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics: WebRender component, addressed in Firefox 161, Firefox ESR 153.8, Thunderbird 161, and Thunderbird 153.8. [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135596), [Bugzilla](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2074187), [Advisory](https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2026-131/)
